description: Checks whether Foxit PDF Reader is installed and, if not, installs it silently for all users from Foxit's MSI. Exit code 10 means it was already installed.
symptoms: فاکسیت ریدر روی سیستم نصب نیست
برنامه‌ای برای باز کردن فایل PDF ندارم

review.source: Foxit PDF Reader MSI from Foxit's enterprise downloads (package_type=msi).
review.notes: Generated by new-install-package.ps1 (msi). Installer not committed: place it with scripts/set-package-files.ps1 -Id foxit-reader-install -File <path to the MSI> -Sign; it is stored as FoxitPDFReader.msi.
